_comment: Extension Market sources. 'repositories' are curated (files verified and mirrored). The workflow also adds CloudStream's community list (recloudstream/cs-repos) and repositories found by GitHub search; those are installed from their source. 'seeds' are extra GitHub repos (owner/name) to probe; 'blocked' are owner/name repos never listed. NSFW extensions are always skipped. Rebuilt every 3 days by .github/workflows/extension-market.yml.

repositories.note: Internet Archive (public-domain films, TV, cartoons) and Dailymotion
